lines.name: 30 corner gussets, 10 gussets cut to this setup's angles, 12 tee gussets and 2 brake plates, laser cut 1/8 inch 6061
lines.note: Six aluminum profiles, three of them cut to the roof and pillar angles of this setup. For one carrier these are OSH Cut's instant-quote prices in 6061-T6: $9.47 a corner gusset, $8.19 a tee gusset, $10.15 to $12.43 for the angled ones and $12.23 a brake plate, about double the earlier allowance. The same plates in softer 5052-H32 were quoted $163.94 lower. The batch figure is still an allowance of $1.60 to $2.00 a plate with no quote behind it, and the one-carrier quote suggests it is low.

lines.name: 2 pneumatic trail wheels, 15 inch 4.00-8
lines.note: $32.89 each, no bulk discount assumed. Ball bearings, 5/8 inch bore and a 4 inch hub are stated by the supplier.

lines.name: Front swivel caster with swivel lock, 10 inch pneumatic, and four bolts
lines.note: Service Caster SCC-100S3504-PNB-BSL at $64.69: 12-3/16 inch mounting height and 350 lb stated, with a bolt-on swivel lock. Plate size and bolt pattern are not on the page.

lines.name: 2 stock-shaft axles, sleeves, spacers, washers and cotters
lines.note: One 5/8 inch x 3 ft plain steel rod at $20.57 (store listing), 12 inches of 3/4 inch DOM tube at $4.99, 5/8 inch washers at $0.15 and cotters at $0.07.

lines.name: 172 sleeved bolted joints
lines.note: Zinc-plated grade 5 bolts, lock nuts and washers at Bolt Depot prices: per 1,000 for the batch, whole boxes of 100 for one build. Sleeves are cut from 3/8 inch x .049 DOM steel tube at $11.66 per 6 ft.

lines.name: Floor and ramp panels, sealed 15/32 inch ACX plywood
lines.note: 1 sheet at $52.00 plus edge and face sealing. Offcuts are charged.

lines.name: Hinge, two latches, carriage bolts and strap hardware
lines.note: Stainless piano hinge 2ZFK4 at $18.19, two Southco TL-20-202-52 stainless draw latches at $11.89, carriage bolts at $0.16. The ramp legs end in printed caps, so they need no feet or inserts. The strap hook is a $4.00 allowance.

lines.name: Wheel chocks, grip, tip-stop feet, floor fasteners, bedding tape and ridge pole
lines.note: Two rubber chocks at $7.49, foam grip tube at $1.95 per 6 inches, two tall leveling mounts at $11.59, rivet nuts at $16.87 per 100, foam strip at $18.99 per 50 ft. Floor screws and the ridge pole are allowances.

lines.name: Parking brake: two push-pull toggle clamps with neoprene-tipped spindles
lines.note: POWERTEC 302F at $10.70 each, $7.64 in a six-pack, 300 lb holding capacity and a 5/16-18 plunger thread stated. DE-STA-CO 507208 neoprene-tipped spindle, 5/16-18, at $4.15 each.

lines.name: Rear suspension: two coil-over shocks, eight bolt-on mount plates, pivot bolts, bushings and mount bolts
lines.note: LvTu 150 mm coil-over at $31.05 each, read on its product page: 30 mm travel, 24 mm wide eyes with an 8 mm bore, springs labeled 150 to 650 lbs. The label is the seller's nominal figure with a rider-weight table, not a measured rate. Bunting EF081008 bronze flanged bearings at $5.29 per pack of three (a listing price) and 1/2-13 x 4 inch grade 5 bolts at $1.64 with $0.41 lock nuts. The mount plates are priced from the one-carrier laser quote, about $4.45 each, and are an allowance in the batch. The pivot crush sleeves, washers, M8 eye bolts and long hanger bolts are allowances. The swing arms and spacer tubes are counted in the tube line.

lines.name: Printed service parts and fixtures
lines.note: About 1.3 liters of solid part volume, most of it the three ramp toes. Priced as consumed filament with a reject reserve, not a printer.

lines.name: Cutting, drilling, deburring and assembly labor
lines.note: Batch: 5.5 h at $25/h. One-off: 15 h. Roughly 300 tube-wall holes per carrier. Timing assumptions, not observed.

lines.name: Packaging
lines.note: Large flat-pack carton set. Outbound freight is separate.

lines.name: Inbound freight allocation
lines.note: Truck freight for long bars in a batch; parcel shipping for one build. Unquoted.

evidence.name: OSH Cut tube laser, all 39 frame tubes of the starting bolted setup, cut and drilled
evidence.unit: one set, as 8 sticks to saw apart, standard lead
evidence.note: Read 2026-11-12 on the instant-quote page after uploading the STEP files from the kit. Every file was recognized as a tube, passed the design check and was matched to its material automatically. As 20 separate tubes the set was quoted at $1,405.06. Packed into 8 sticks with the same holes, to be sawn apart at 25 marked lines, it was quoted at $1,195.44. Subtotals before shipping and tax, which the page shows only after sign-in. Bars for the same tubes cost $639.68. Nothing was ordered.

evidence.name: OSH Cut laser-cut plates for one starting bolted carrier, 1/8 inch 6061-T6
evidence.note: Read 2026-11-12 on the same page after uploading the eight DXF files: 30 corner gussets at $9.47, 12 tee gussets at $8.19, 10 angled gussets at $10.15 to $12.43, 2 brake plates at $12.23 and 8 shock mount plates at about $4.45. All passed the design check. The same plates in 5052-H32 came to $383.84. With the eight tube sticks the whole metal order was $1,746.66 at the standard lead of 7 business days, $2,357.87 at 6 and $2,532.72 at 5, before shipping and tax. Nothing was ordered.

evidence.name: Mutual Screw FC1198-25-S-12 round spacer, 3/8 OD x 1/4 ID x 1 inch, clear zinc steel, pack of 250
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12: $184.32 per 250, $0.74 each. The same size as the bolt sleeves, ready cut. The page gives the hole as 1/4 inch with no tolerance, so check that a 1/4 inch bolt slides through before relying on it.

allowances: Tube for one build: the supplier ships bars over 8 ft by truck, so the one-carrier scenario buys 8 ft bars at $58.08 for the 1/8 inch 6061-T6 and $41.60 for the 1/16 inch 6063-T52, both read on the supplier page. The batch buys 24 ft and 21 ft bars.
Run wheels: $60 each is an allowance. No 20 inch pneumatic wheel with a 5/8 inch bore and a suitable rating was found, so the 20 inch wheel remains an open selection.

Plates: no quote was run. OSH Cut shows instant pricing for uploaded DXF files without an account; SendCutSend lists .125 inch 6061-T6 and .125 inch 304 stainless, accepts DXF, has no minimum quantity and ships laser parts in 1 to 3 days, but asks for a sign-up. Uploading the files is left to the owner, so the gusset, brake plate and hanger lines stay allowances.

Front caster: the maker's shop page for the same caster series lists a 4 x 4-1/2 inch top plate, bolt holes at 2-5/8 x 3-5/8 inch slotted to 3 x 3 inch, 3/8 inch mounting bolts and a 12-3/16 inch mounting height. The design puts the beams 85.7 mm apart and the holes 70 mm apart, inside those slots. Its swivel radius is not published; the 185 mm sweep comes from CasterHQ CB-SPC10, a same-size caster that states 7-1/4 inch. The maker sells the version without a swivel lock at $41.38, and Harbor Freight 63799 is $19.99 with no stated height.

Parking brake: a push-pull toggle clamp on an arm over each rear tire, with a neoprene-tipped spindle whose 5/16-18 thread matches the clamp plunger. The spindle tip is listed at 0.83 inch on one page and about 0.5 inch elsewhere. The clamp, the plate it hangs on and the arm are untested as a brake. Two rubber chocks stay in the kit for slopes.
Still allowances: the tailgate strap hook, floor screws, the ridge pole (the 4 ft store length is too short for the starting cabin), clamp screws, and caster nuts and sleeves.
Listing prices, read on a search or category page and not a product page: 5/8 inch steel rod $20.57, rivet nuts $16.87 per 100, foam grip $1.95 per 6 inches, foam strip $18.99 per 50 ft.
Stainless option: the stainless bolt is an observed $30.75 per 100. Stainless nuts and washers were not priced; the $0.23 per joint upgrade includes a $0.10 allowance for them.

Sprung rear: the travel, sag and spring figures are arithmetic from the drawn arm geometry and an assumed spring rate. No shock has been fitted, no ride has been measured, and no comparison with any other product is claimed. The parking brake presses on a tire that now moves with the load, which is unresolved.
Axle sleeve fit: the linked 3/4 inch x .065 wall DOM tube is 0.620 inch inside, 0.005 under the 5/8 inch axle. Ream it to 5/8 or buy .058 wall, 0.634 inside, which the drawn numbers assume.

Laser quotes: on 2026-11-12 the tube and plate files for the starting bolted setup were uploaded to OSH Cut with the owner's permission. All passed its design check. These are quotes for one carrier on one day, before shipping and tax, and nothing was ordered. No other setup, and no batch quantity, has been quoted. The counted one-carrier total uses the quoted plate prices and still assumes stock bars cut and drilled by hand, because that is the cheaper way to get the tubes.

Welded build: the welding line is arithmetic on assumed shop rates and minutes per joint. No fabricator has seen the drawings. A welded frame also ships assembled, and outbound truck freight for a carton that size is not in any total here.

Mill-quantity tube: the second total prices tube by weight at $4.00 per pound plus 8% scrap. That rate is an assumption with no quote behind it. The listed-price total stays the headline until a mill or distributor quote exists.
